ARTICLE 10 — EARLY TERMINATION
A party may terminate this Agreement for convenience only after the initial twelve-month commitment
period has elapsed. Written notice must be delivered to the other party. The amended notice requirement is
ninety (90) days, and the notice period begins on the date the written notice is acknowledged by the
receiving party.
ARTICLE 11 — DATA RETENTION
The Provider shall retain customer records for seven (7) years following expiration or termination. Records
may be securely destroyed after the retention period unless a longer period is required by applicable law.
ARTICLE 12 — AUDIT
The Client may conduct one compliance audit per calendar year upon fifteen (15) business days written
notice. The Provider shall reasonably cooperate with the audit and provide records relevant to contractual
compliance.
ARTICLE 13 — INSURANCE
The Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than INR 1 crore during the term of
this Agreement. Evidence of coverage shall be provided upon reasonable written request.
